title: Common Pitfalls
concept: Learn the most common XIOM mistakes and how to avoid them — from semicolons to type mismatches.
why: Knowing what breaks helps you avoid it. These pitfalls catch every beginner — learn them once, save hours of debugging.
tips: No semicolons on tail expressions in value-returning functions
Use Float64 when you need decimal division results
Always initialize variables when declaring them
Make sure every code path returns a value
common_mistakes: See the entire lesson — these ARE the common mistakes!
